evidence.quote: 94層:セルリオン...セルリオンを橋の所まで引っ張ってくる前に必ず橋の前のヘルリオンを倒しておくこと...セルリオンの顎の先端辺りまで近づいてエグザクトオンスロートで定期的に押し返す必要がある。
evidence.translation: Floor 94: Cellurion... Before pulling Cellurion to the bridge make sure to defeat Hellion in front of the bridge... approach near the tip of Cellurion's chin and push it back periodically with Exact Onslaught.

facts.subject: Crimson Spinner
facts.text: On Floor 96, lure Crimson Spinner between pillars, and counter Destiny Net using Exact Onslaught.

evidence.quote: 96層:クリムゾンスピナー...全く後が見えない状態で柱の間に誘導しなければならない...ディスティニーネットを撃たれたらエグザクトオンスロートで潰そう。
evidence.translation: Floor 96: Crimson Spinner... Must lure it between pillars without seeing behind... If Destiny Net is used crush it with Exact Onslaught.

facts.subject: Inferno Dragon
facts.text: On Floor 97, Sneaking and Invisible are essential when pulling Inferno Dragon into the passage to avoid extra enemies.

evidence.quote: 97層:インフェルノドラゴン...近所にアクティブの敵が多くいるので、余計な敵を引っかけない様にスニーキングとインビジブルは必須。...インフェルノドラゴンを通路に引き込む時は
evidence.translation: Floor 97: Inferno Dragon... Many active enemies nearby, so Sneaking and Invisible are essential to avoid extra enemies... When pulling Inferno Dragon into the passage

facts.subject: Sachi's Message
facts.text: Sachi's message can be used in Kirito's room.

evidence.quote: サチのメッセージはキリトの部屋で使える。
evidence.translation: Sachi's message can be used in Kirito's room.

facts.subject: Mabethck
facts.text: In Unearthed Grotto on Floor 84, NM Mabethck and antlion can be lured to entrance rocks where Mabethck gets caught for safe attacks.

evidence.quote: 84層：抉られた岩洞 NM：マーベスク...なのでタゲられたら入口付近まで戻ります。併せてアントライオンも一緒にトレインします。...すると入口付近の岩に引っ掛かってくれます。...通常攻撃だけでも安全に撃破可能。ソードスキル打ち放題。
evidence.translation: Floor 84: Unearthed Grotto NM: Mabethck... If targeted return near the entrance while training antlion together... It gets caught on the rock near the entrance... Safely defeatable with normal attacks alone and unlimited Sword Skills.

facts.subject: Necro Dragon
facts.text: In Dragon Ruins Center Room on Floor 88, retreating when targeted makes NM Necro Dragon get stuck so normal attacks can hit continuously.

evidence.quote: 88層：封竜遺跡 中央の間 NM：ネクロドラゴン...タゲられたら引き返します。...やっぱり引っ掛かります。...微妙に距離調整すると通常攻撃を当て続けられます
evidence.translation: Floor 88: Dragon Ruins Center Room NM: Necro Dragon... When targeted retreat... It gets stuck... With subtle distance adjustment you can continue hitting normal attacks

facts.subject: Thrill of the Giant Spider
facts.text: On Floor 96 Road of Wisdom, trapping NM Crimson Spinner near Corridor of Sturdy Lock gives 32000 to 38400 EXP at Lv129, and cancelling Thrill of the Giant Spider at NPC Kirby allows repeated fights.

evidence.quote: 96層：叡智に連なる街道 NM：クリムゾンスピナー...『堅剛なる錠の回廊』の入口付近にある大小の柱の間に引っ掛けます...そこから奥義連発！ 1～2回目32000exp 3～4回目38400exp（Lv129）...倒し終わったらNPCカービーの所へ行き『巨大グモの戦慄』クエストを『キャンセル』...もう一回クエスト受領すると何度でもクリムゾンスピナー退治出来ます。
evidence.translation: Floor 96: Road of Wisdom NM: Crimson Spinner... Trap it between large and small pillars near the entrance of Corridor of Sturdy Lock... Repeated secret skills from there! 1st-2nd time 32000exp 3rd-4th time 38400exp (Lv129)... After defeating, go to NPC Kirby and cancel the Thrill of the Giant Spider quest... Accepting the quest again lets you defeat Crimson Spinner repeatedly.

facts.subject: Saw The Dragon's Figure
facts.text: For quest Saw The Dragon's Figure on Floor 97 Coffin of Death King 1F, NM Inferno Dragon grants 38400 EXP around Lv.130 and can be repeated by cancelling at NPC Kirby.

evidence.quote: クエスト『竜の姿を見た！』 97層：極死王の霊柩1F NM：インフェルノドラゴン...討伐後、NPCカービーでクエストキャンセルすると何度でも受領可...Lv.130前後でほぼ毎回38400exp獲得出来た
evidence.translation: Quest Saw The Dragon's Figure! Floor 97: Coffin of Death King 1F NM: Inferno Dragon... After defeating, cancelling the quest at NPC Kirby allows accepting repeatedly... At around Lv.130 acquired 38400exp almost every time

facts.subject: Date Conversation
facts.text: In Arc Sophia date conversations, beginning conversation while seated on benches or fountains via X button increases the number of times you can speak.

evidence.quote: アークソフィアでのデート会話では、パートナーと座った状態で話はじめると話せる回数が増えます。...×ボタンで、ベンチや噴水、とりあえず座れるところなら座れます。
evidence.translation: In date conversations in Arc Sophia, beginning conversation while seated with your partner increases the number of times you can speak... With X button, you can sit on benches, fountains, or wherever you can sit.

facts.subject: Hollow Strea
facts.text: Against final boss Hollow Strea, unleash secret skills when HP is red and dash away, and heal in advance because small area attacks reach room corners in front of doors.

evidence.quote: ラスボスホロウストレアは、後半になると連続で広範囲技しかけてきます。でも敵のHPが赤くなってたら...奥義をぶっぱなったほうがいい。...んで奥義のちカーソル敵からはずしてもうダッシュで逃げるbこれを繰り返せば倒せる！...ちなみに時々小範囲技も使ってきますが...部屋の隅っこ(ドアの前)にいてもダメージくらうのであらかじめ回復を！！
evidence.translation: Final boss Hollow Strea continuously uses wide area attacks in the latter half. But if enemy HP is red... better to fire off secret skills... Then after secret skill remove cursor from enemy and dash away to repeat and defeat! By the way sometimes uses small area attacks... you take damage even at room corners in front of doors so heal in advance!!

facts.subject: 79層
facts.text: The 79th Floor is a waterway-type labyrinth.

evidence.quote: 金づちのリーファが元気に79層（水路型の迷宮）を攻略する矛盾が起きてしまっています。
evidence.translation: A contradiction occurs where Leafa, who cannot swim, energetically clears the 79th Floor (a waterway-type labyrinth).

facts.subject: VITA版
facts.text: When playing on PS Vita, assigning the D-pad to the right stick, Start to the bottom right of the screen, and Select to the bottom left is recommended.

evidence.quote: 操作は右スティックを十字キーにふって画面右下をスタート、左下をセレクトにふると良いかも。
evidence.translation: For controls, it might be good to assign the right stick to the D-pad, bottom right of the screen to Start, and bottom left to Select.

facts.subject: DLC
facts.text: Downloadable content for the game consists of additional dungeons, additional bosses, and school swimsuits.

evidence.quote: 追加ダンジョン、追加ボス、スク水のみ。
evidence.translation: Additional dungeons, additional bosses, and school swimsuits only.

facts.subject: 女性プレイヤー
facts.text: The player can take all female players to bed.

evidence.quote: その気になれば全女性プレイヤーをベッドに連れ込むことも可。
evidence.translation: If you feel like it, you can take all female players to bed.

facts.subject: マルチエンド
facts.text: The game features multiple endings for the 5 partner heroines and Yui, but has none for Klein.

evidence.quote: Q.マルチエンドなんでしょ？何種類？...5人＋ユイ。クラインはありません。
evidence.translation: Q. Are there multiple endings? How many types?... 5 partners + Yui. Klein has none.

facts.subject: ハードモード
facts.text: A patch released on 2013/06/06 provides balance adjustments and adds Hard Mode for the 2nd playthrough.

evidence.quote: 2013/06/06より修正パッチ配信。バランス調整＋2周目にハードモード追加。
evidence.translation: Patch released on 2013/06/06. Balance adjustments + Hard Mode added in 2nd playthrough.

facts.subject: ストーリー
facts.text: The game's story is an IF scenario developing from the battle with Heathcliff.

evidence.quote: ヒースクリフとのバトルからのIF展開。
evidence.translation: An IF development branching from the battle with Heathcliff.

facts.subject: シリカ
facts.text: By the time she forms a party, Silica is at a level in the late 80s suitable for the clearers.

evidence.quote: パーティを組む頃にはちゃんと攻略組相当レベル（80台後半）になっています。
evidence.translation: By the time she forms a party, she is properly at a level equivalent to the clearing group (late 80s).

facts.subject: リーファ
facts.text: Leafa appeared in Aincrad because she could not bear seeing her bedridden brother and rushed into SAO using a NerveGear hidden by a friend.

evidence.quote: 彼女は寝たきりの兄貴に耐えられなくなり、友達の隠し持っていたナーヴギアでSAOに突撃したためにアインクラッドに現れた。
evidence.translation: She appeared in Aincrad because she could not bear her bedridden brother and rushed into SAO using a NerveGear a friend had hidden.

facts.subject: バトルシステム
facts.text: In the early game with few skills combat involves watching auto-attacks and occasionally using skills, but eventually becomes busy with giving instructions and firing skills consecutively.

evidence.quote: スキルの少ない序盤はオートアタックを眺めてたまにスキルを使う程度だが、最終的に指示出しやスキル連発したりでかなり忙しくなる。
evidence.translation: In the early stage with few skills, you just watch auto-attacks and occasionally use skills, but eventually it becomes quite busy giving instructions and firing skills in succession.

facts.subject: Recording Crystal
facts.text: Using a Recording Crystal while alone in Kirito's room triggers a flashback scene of Sachi.

evidence.quote: 後、一人の時に自室で記録結晶を使ってみよう。
evidence.translation: Also, try using a recording crystal in your room when you are alone.

facts.subject: Katana
facts.text: Katana can be equipped, but its skill proficiency will not increase unless Curved Sword skill is raised and the prerequisite skill is acquired.

evidence.quote: 刀は装備こそできるが、曲刀スキルを上げて前提スキル習得済みでないとスキルが一切伸びない。
evidence.translation: Although katana can be equipped, the skill will not grow at all unless you raise curved sword skill and have acquired the prerequisite skill.

facts.subject: Katana
facts.text: Most Katana skills possess the diamond attribute, making them easy to cancel.

evidence.quote: なお、刀はスキルの大半が◇属性だったりといろいろ玄人向け。
evidence.translation: Furthermore, katana is for experts as most of its skills have the diamond attribute.

facts.subject: Equipment
facts.text: Because shop prices are extremely high, weapons other than your main weapon should be acquired from treasure chests and Last Attack bonuses.

evidence.quote: 物価が鬼のように高いので、メインで使う武器以外は買うより宝箱やLAボーナスで入手していきたい。
evidence.translation: Because prices are insanely high, you should acquire weapons other than your main weapon from treasure chests and LA bonuses rather than buying them.

facts.subject: Weapon Proficiency
facts.text: Weapon skill increases easily up to around 200, slows down rapidly past 500, and becomes a grind beyond 700.

evidence.quote: 武器スキルは200くらいまでは簡単に上がるが、500を超えたあたりから急激に伸びづらくなり、700超えると苦行。
evidence.translation: Weapon skill rises easily up to around 200, but from around 500 it becomes sharply harder to raise, and beyond 700 it is torture.

facts.subject: Skill Points
facts.text: Learning every sword skill and battle skill requires 1079 spt total, needing 1000 mastery in all weapons plus 790 internal mastery points out of 3000.

evidence.quote: 全てのソードスキル・バトルスキルを習得するには合計で1079spt必要。これはすべての武器の熟練度を1000にした上で...3000まで上がるシステム内部の熟練度をさらに790も稼がなければいけない。
evidence.translation: To learn all sword skills and battle skills, a total of 1079 spt is required. This requires raising proficiency of all weapons to 1000... and additionally earning 790 internal system proficiency that goes up to 3000.

facts.subject: Sword Skill
facts.text: Each weapon has 9 to 10 sword skills, but there are only 8 skill slots available.

evidence.quote: ソードスキル9～10個に対してスキル枠は8なのであらかじめ切り捨てるスキルを決めておく
evidence.translation: There are 9 to 10 sword skills compared to only 8 skill slots, so decide in advance which skills to discard

facts.subject: Battle Skill
facts.text: HP and SP recovery battle skills often affect the entire party and are essential for preventing casualties during floor boss battles.

evidence.quote: HP・SP回復系はPT全体が対象のものも多く非常に便利。フロアボス戦で戦死者を出したくない場合は特に重要。
evidence.translation: HP and SP recovery skills often target the entire party and are very useful. They are especially critical if you do not want casualties in floor boss fights.

facts.subject: Floor Boss
facts.text: Stun and Skill Seal battle skills are effective against floor bosses and can incapacitate them for long periods when multiple are equipped.

evidence.quote: スタン・スキル封印系は階層ボスにも効果があり、複数セットしておくと長時間、相手を無力化することができる。
evidence.translation: Stun and skill seal skills are effective even against floor bosses, and equipping multiple can incapacitate the opponent for a long time.

facts.subject: SP Charge
facts.text: SP Charge is a Tactics battle skill derived from the Spear skill tree.

evidence.quote: SPが足りないなら槍と細剣からそれぞれ派生する、「戦術」の「SPチャージ」と「電光石火」の「ライトニングアタック」が有用。
evidence.translation: If you lack SP, Tactics' SP Charge and Lightning's Lightning Attack, derived respectively from spear and rapier, are useful.

facts.subject: Lightning Attack
facts.text: Lightning Attack is a Lightning battle skill derived from the Rapier skill tree.

evidence.quote: SPが足りないなら槍と細剣からそれぞれ派生する、「戦術」の「SPチャージ」と「電光石火」の「ライトニングアタック」が有用。
evidence.translation: If you lack SP, Tactics' SP Charge and Lightning's Lightning Attack, derived respectively from spear and rapier, are useful.

facts.subject: Partner AI
facts.text: Developing partner AI requires Crimson Weapon and hate management skills.

evidence.quote: パートナーのAI育成にはクリムゾンウェポンやヘイト管理のスキルが必須。
evidence.translation: For partner AI training, Crimson Weapon and hate management skills are essential.

facts.subject: Sword Skill
facts.text: Diamond attribute sword skills are easily interrupted by regular enemy attacks and waste SP, so star attribute skills should be prioritized.

evidence.quote: ソードスキルは◇と☆の二種があり、前者は通常攻撃で簡単にキャンセルされSPも無駄になる。☆印を優先するといい。
evidence.translation: Sword skills have two types, diamond and star; the former is easily cancelled by normal attacks and wastes SP. You should prioritize star-marked ones.

facts.subject: Secret Skill
facts.text: Secret skills carry the diamond attribute but can be triggered regardless of distance from the enemy.

evidence.quote: 奥義技は◇印だが、距離に関係なく発動可能。
evidence.translation: Secret arts are diamond attribute, but can be activated regardless of distance.

facts.subject: Partner Selection
facts.text: Partners are fixed per floor from Floor 76 to Floor 80, and become selectable from Floor 81 onward.

evidence.quote: 76～80まで層ごとに固定、81層から選択可能。
evidence.translation: Fixed per floor from 76 to 80, selectable starting from floor 81.

facts.subject: Partner Level
facts.text: Partners other than Asuna join with an initial level in the late 80s, requiring level training through Crime Servant to survive.

evidence.quote: アスナ以外の初期レベルは80台後半。原作通りの階層＋10程度まで上がっているが、そのままでは力不足。...クライムサーバントでちゃんとレベルを上げてやること。
evidence.translation: Initial levels other than Asuna are in the late 80s. They are raised to about floor + 10 as in the original story, but as is they lack strength... Level them up properly with Crime Servant.

facts.subject: Skill Assist Bug
facts.text: A bug resetting partner Skill Assist to level 1 can usually be resolved by returning to town or restarting the game.

evidence.quote: 街に戻ったりゲームの再起動で治ることが多い。
evidence.translation: It is often cured by returning to town or restarting the game.

facts.subject: Partner Equipment Bug
facts.text: Partners will appear with their weapons unequipped if they share a map with Kirito while not in a party, which fixes upon entering another map.

evidence.quote: キリトさんと同じマップにいてパーティを組んでいないと武器を外した状態になる。バグか仕様かは不明。違うMAPに行くと治る。
evidence.translation: If in the same map as Kirito and not forming a party, they enter an unequipped weapon state. Unclear whether bug or feature. Cured by going to a different map.

facts.subject: Treant Dominator
facts.text: The Treant Dominator on Floor 77 and the scorpion swarm outside the town gate on Floor 81 pose deadly hazards for Assault Team members.

evidence.quote: 77層のトレントドミネーター、81層街門前のサソリの群れが特に危険。
evidence.translation: Floor 77's Treant Dominator and Floor 81's swarm of scorpions in front of the town gate are especially dangerous.

facts.subject: Assault Team
facts.text: Assault Team members have stat tiers prioritized by Avatar Contest winners, standard leaders, and general guild members, with males having higher HP and two-member guilds having higher stats than three-member guilds.

evidence.quote: 攻略組はアバターコンテスト出身、通常リーダー、その他ギルメンの3タイプがおり、この順に確率補正などが付与されており能力が高い。...一般的RPG同様、女性より男性のほうがHPが高く、最初から二人組のギルドは3人組より能力が高め。
evidence.translation: The Assault Team has 3 types: Avatar Contest winners, normal leaders, and other guild members, with higher abilities and stat bonuses in this order... Like typical RPGs, males have higher HP than females, and guilds that are two-person from the start have higher stats than three-person guilds.

facts.subject: Assault Team
facts.text: Recruiting a dedicated tank equipped with a shield and heavy armor requires bringing in an Assault Team member.

evidence.quote: また、盾と重鎧装備の純粋タンクが欲しい場合は攻略組から引っ張ってこないとならない。
evidence.translation: Also, if you want a pure tank equipped with shield and heavy armor, you must pull one from the Assault Team.

facts.subject: Assault Team
facts.text: Early floor boss raids feature the Knights of the Blood and Holy Dragon Alliance guilds, followed by the Two-Handed Axe Research Group and Those Who Inherit the Stars.

evidence.quote: 開始直後は原作の2大ギルド《血盟騎士団》と《聖竜連合》が出てくるが、一周目ではその後は当分《両手斧研究会》と《星を継ぐもの》でほぼ固定される。
evidence.translation: Right after starting, the 2 major guilds from the original story, Knights of the Blood and Holy Dragon Alliance, appear, but afterwards in the first playthrough it is mostly fixed with Two-Handed Axe Research Group and Those Who Inherit the Stars for a while.

facts.subject: Assault Team Requests
facts.text: Assault Team member locations can be tracked via FRIEND in the menu, and quest targets display an exclamation mark bubble above their head when in the appropriate field.

evidence.quote: 攻略組PTはゲーム内の時間に合わせて街と特定フィールドを往復している。メニューのFRIENDから相手の現在地が確認できる。...依頼が解決できるエリアにいると頭上に（！）の吹き出しが出るので一緒に敵を倒すと進行。
evidence.translation: Assault Team parties commute between town and specific fields according to in-game time. You can check the other person's current location from FRIEND in the menu... When they are in an area where the request can be resolved, an exclamation mark (!) balloon appears above their head, and defeating enemies together progresses it.

facts.subject: Floor Boss
facts.text: Each floor boss can only be fought once per playthrough, but resetting at the results screen before activating returns the player to just before the strategy meeting.

evidence.quote: 各階層のボスは１回きり。どうしても全LAを取得したいなら、アクティベートの前にリザルト画面で再起動。攻略会議の直前まで戻れる。
evidence.translation: Each floor boss is only once. If you really want to obtain all LAs, restart on the result screen before activating. You can return to right before the strategy meeting.

facts.subject: Floor Boss
facts.text: Defeating a floor boss with Kirito dealing the Last Attack awards fixed bonus equipment such as the Duel series, whereas partner finishing blows do not award the item.

evidence.quote: 取るとデュエルシリーズなどの強い装備を一つ入手できる。キリトがLAを取る必要があり、パートナーがトドメを刺してもアイテムは入手できない。各階層でドロップアイテムは固定で、クリアランクによる変化はない。
evidence.translation: Obtaining it yields a piece of strong equipment such as the Duel series. Kirito must get the LA; even if a partner lands the finishing blow, the item cannot be obtained. Drop items are fixed for each floor and do not change based on clear rank.

facts.subject: Floor Boss Evaluation
facts.text: Floor boss evaluation rank depends on damage dealt, damage received, attack interruptions, and zero casualties, while clear time is not factored into the score.

evidence.quote: 判定条件は与えたダメージ、受けた被ダメージ、攻撃妨害、戦死者の4つ。...攻撃妨害はボスのソードスキルなどをバッシュなどでキャンセルすれば加点。そして戦死者はなしが前提で、一人でも死ぬとBランク以上にならない。クリアタイムは計算されないので注意。
evidence.translation: Evaluation conditions are 4: damage dealt, damage received, attack interruption, and casualties... Attack interruption awards points if you cancel boss sword skills with bash etc. And zero casualties is a prerequisite; if even one person dies, it will not be B rank or higher. Note that clear time is not calculated.

facts.subject: Goblin Leader
facts.text: The Goblin Leader is found inside a cave accessed by following the left wall from the entrance and dropping down in Wild Pioneer Land on Floor 77.

evidence.quote: 77層、荒らぶる開拓地。入口から左壁沿いに進み、降りたら洞窟内。
evidence.translation: Floor 77, Wild Pioneer Land. Proceed along the left wall from the entrance, drop down and it is inside the cave.

facts.subject: Camilla's Request
facts.text: The Sweet Sap required for Camilla's request is dropped by Treant monsters rather than goblins.

evidence.quote: ゴブリンを狩っているが、対象アイテムを落とすのはトレント（樹人）のモンスター。
evidence.translation: They are hunting goblins, but the target item is dropped by Treant (tree-man) monsters.

facts.subject: Camilla's Request
facts.text: Unlike standard NPC assistance requests, Camilla's request requires collecting the items and turning them in rather than fighting together.

evidence.quote: 他の手伝いと違ってカミラたちと一緒に戦う必要はなく、アイテムを集める→渡す、という流れ。
evidence.translation: Unlike other help requests, you do not need to fight together with Camilla and the others; the flow is collect items -> hand them over.

facts.subject: Camilla's Request
facts.text: Pre-collecting Sweet Sap in the preceding forest allows immediate completion of Camilla's request when it activates.

evidence.quote: ひとつ手前の森をぐるぐる回って事前にアイテム集めておくと、依頼が進行→即達成となり楽に終わる。
evidence.translation: If you circle around the preceding forest to collect the item in advance, the request will progress -> immediately achieve, making it easy to finish.

facts.subject: Teleport Crystal
facts.text: Teleport Crystals cannot be bought in shops and only 3 to 6 can be gathered per floor.

evidence.quote: 転移結晶。非売品。各層で3〜6個程度は拾えるが、使いすぎに注意。
evidence.translation: Teleport crystal. Not for sale. About 3 to 6 can be picked up on each floor, but beware of using too many.

facts.subject: Teleport Crystal
facts.text: Partnering with Asuna grants unlimited Teleport Crystal usage as she supplies her own crystals.

evidence.quote: アスナさんはどこからともなく結晶を調達してくる為、コンビ組んでいれば彼女の結晶を使い放題。
evidence.translation: Because Asuna procures crystals from out of nowhere, if you form a duo with her you can use her crystals unlimitedly.

facts.subject: Floor Boss Last Attack Equipment
facts.text: Floor boss Last Attack bonus equipment and fallen Assault Team members are permanently missable.

evidence.quote: 階層ボスのLA(ラストアタック)ボーナス装備、攻略組の死亡
evidence.translation: Floor boss LA (Last Attack) bonus equipment, death of Assault Team members

facts.subject: Rage Ring
facts.text: Hidden passive skills on equipment can be viewed on the Active Skill screen by pressing SELECT, such as the Rage Ring which grants permanent Counter.

evidence.quote: 装備品の隠し効果。SELECTのアクティブスキル画面で確認できる。...例えばバトルスキルのカウンター効果は時間制限アリだが、レイジリング装備中は永続カウンターがつく
evidence.translation: Hidden effects of equipment. Can be confirmed on the active skill screen with SELECT... For example, the counter effect of battle skills has a time limit, but while equipping the Rage Ring, permanent counter is applied.

facts.subject: Dark Repulser
facts.text: The genuine Dark Repulser is obtained exclusively as the Last Attack reward from defeating the 100th Floor boss.

evidence.quote: 本物が見あたらないのは、誰も到達していない100層ボスのLAだからだ！
evidence.translation: The real one cannot be found because it is the LA of the 100th floor boss that no one has reached!

facts.subject: Lambent Light
facts.text: Lambent Light is rewarded as the Last Attack bonus from defeating the 91st Floor boss.

evidence.quote: 他にも色々知っているぜ？ランベントライトが91層LAだとか、エリュシデータは98層LAだとかな。
evidence.translation: I also know various other things: Lambent Light is the 91st floor LA, and Elucidator is the 98th floor LA.

facts.subject: Elucidator
facts.text: Elucidator is rewarded as the Last Attack bonus from defeating the 98th Floor boss.

evidence.quote: 他にも色々知っているぜ？ランベントライトが91層LAだとか、エリュシデータは98層LAだとかな。
evidence.translation: I also know various other things: Lambent Light is the 91st floor LA, and Elucidator is the 98th floor LA.

facts.subject: Dual Wield
facts.text: Dual Wield is available from the start, using two equipped One-Handed Swords.

evidence.quote: は最初から使える。...を2本装備すること。
evidence.translation: Dual Wield can be used from the start. Equip two one-handed swords.

facts.subject: Battle Skill
facts.text: Unlocking battle skills requires raising various weapons, and enemies with extreme attribute resistances make even development advisable.

evidence.quote: の解放にも各種の武器を育てるのが必須の他、極端な属性耐性を持つ敵（突：スケルトン系、打：スライム系）もいるのでまんべんなく育てたほうが良い。
evidence.translation: In addition to raising various weapons being mandatory to unlock battle skills, there are also enemies with extreme attribute resistances (Thrust: Skeletons, Strike: Slimes), so it is better to raise them evenly.

facts.subject: Dagger
facts.text: Daggers have a default Poison debuff and good skill fuel efficiency and attack interval, but low attack power.

evidence.quote: | 毒 | 良好なスキル燃費と攻撃間隔。武器にはST異常、スキルには能力ダウンのデバフが豊富 | 攻撃力が低め
evidence.translation: Dagger | Poison | Good skill fuel efficiency and attack interval. Weapons have status ailments, skills have plenty of stat-down debuffs | Low attack power

facts.subject: One-Handed Sword
facts.text: One-Handed Swords have a high weapon stat increase and are easy to handle, with no notable flaws but no sharp strengths.

evidence.quote: 武器の能力上昇値が高め、扱いやすい | 欠点らしい欠点がないが、尖った長所もない
evidence.translation: High weapon stat increase, easy to handle | No notable flaws, but lacks sharp advantages

facts.subject: Two-Handed Sword
facts.text: Two-Handed Swords have high-power wide-area skills, a star-attribute secret art, and many CT-rate weapons, but terrible skill fuel efficiency.

evidence.quote: 高威力かつ広範囲のスキル、☆属性の奥義。CT率補正武器が多い | 劣悪なスキル燃費
evidence.translation: High power and wide-area skills, star-attribute secret art. Many weapons with critical rate bonuses | Terrible skill fuel efficiency

facts.subject: Rapier
facts.text: Rapiers activate sword skills quickly and have many weapons with hit-rate bonuses.

evidence.quote: ソードスキルの発動が早い、命中補正武器が多い
evidence.translation: Fast sword skill activation, many weapons with hit rate bonuses

facts.subject: Katana
facts.text: Katanas have a default Bleed debuff and balance power with skill fuel efficiency, but their star-attribute skill is only level 1 and they unlock very late.

evidence.quote: | 出血 | 威力とスキル燃費が両立、出血デバフがデフォ | ☆属性スキルがレベル1のみ。解禁も非常に遅い
evidence.translation: Bleed | Both power and skill fuel efficiency, default bleed debuff | Star-attribute skill only at level 1. Very late unlock

facts.subject: Curved Sword
facts.text: Curved Swords have a default Absorb debuff but unlock late relative to their performance, after learning One-Handed Sword SA4.

evidence.quote: | 吸収 |  | 性能の割に解禁が遅め（片手剣SA4習得）
evidence.translation: Absorb | | Late unlock considering performance (requires learning One-Handed Sword SA4)

facts.subject: Dual Wield
facts.text: Dual Wield has high-performance skills and stacking one-handed sword stat bonuses, but lacks a decisive finisher against multiple enemies.

evidence.quote: 高性能なスキル群、片手剣の能力補正が重複 | 複数相手の決め手にかける
evidence.translation: High-performance skill set, stat bonuses of one-handed swords duplicate | Lacks decisive finishing power against multiple opponents

facts.subject: One-Handed Club
facts.text: One-Handed Clubs have a default Paralysis debuff and are the only weapon with Strike-attribute normal attacks, but have long attack intervals.

evidence.quote: | 麻痺 | 唯一の通常攻撃打属性 | 攻撃間隔長め
evidence.translation: Paralysis | The only normal attack with strike attribute | Long attack interval

facts.subject: Two-Handed Axe
facts.text: Two-Handed Axes have a default Stun debuff and high-power sword skills plus a star-attribute secret art, but long attack intervals.

evidence.quote: スタン | 高威力のソードスキル、☆属性の奥義 | 攻撃間隔長め
evidence.translation: Stun | High power sword skills, star-attribute secret art | Long attack interval

facts.subject: Spear
facts.text: Spears have a default Seal debuff, sword skills with abundant abnormal debuffs that branch into useful battle skills, but are unreliable as a damage source.

evidence.quote: 封印 | ソードスキルは異常系デバフが豊富。便利なバトルスキルへ派生。 | ダメージ源としては頼りない
evidence.translation: Seal | Sword skills have abundant abnormal status debuffs. Derives into convenient battle skills. | Unreliable as a damage source

facts.subject: Shine Circular
facts.text: Get Dual Wield's Shine Circular first; using it at higher levels mostly handles regular enemy fights.

evidence.quote: のシャイン・サーキュラーを取っておこう。レベルを上げてこれを撃っていれば雑魚戦はだいたいなんとかなる。
evidence.translation: For now, get Dual Wield's Shine Circular. If you raise your level and use this, mob fights will mostly be handled.

facts.subject: Round Accel
facts.text: Dagger's Round Accel and Two-Handed Axe's Whirlwind are very strong sword skills.

evidence.quote: [短剣](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/64.html "短剣 \(3581d\)")のラウンドアクセル、[両手斧](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/70.html "両手斧 \(3578d\)")のワールウインド、トランプルアクト（パーフェクションスタイルと併用）が非常に優秀。
evidence.translation: Dagger's Round Accel, Two-Handed Axe's Whirlwind, and Trample Act (used together with Perfection Style) are excellent.

facts.subject: Two-Handed Axe and Two-Handed Sword secret arts
facts.text: The secret arts of Two-Handed Axe and Two-Handed Sword have the star attribute and are hard to cancel, though they have drawbacks like weak power or terrible fuel efficiency.

evidence.quote: の奥義技は☆属性。奥義にしては威力控えめ、あるいは燃費が異常なまでに劣悪などの欠点はあるがキャンセルされにくいのは大きい。
evidence.translation: The secret arts of two-handed axe and two-handed sword have star attribute. They have drawbacks like modest power for a secret art or terrible fuel efficiency, but being hard to cancel is huge.

facts.subject: Hashish
facts.text: Hashish has the highest stats numerically, but actual performance depends on equipment and skill issues.

evidence.quote: 数値の上での最強はハシーシュ。装備やスキルの問題があるため、実際の性能はまた別であるが。
evidence.translation: The strongest in terms of numbers is Hashish. Due to equipment and skill issues, actual performance is another matter though.

facts.subject: Treant Dominator
facts.text: The large Treant in the same area is the SNM Treant Dominator, a very strong enemy, so lure its minions out with knives.

evidence.quote: 同エリア内の大きいトレントは例のSNMトレントドミネーター。相当の強敵なので取り巻きをナイフで釣るといい。
evidence.translation: The large treant in the same area is that SNM Treant Dominator. It is a considerably tough enemy, so lure out its minions with knives.

facts.subject: START OF LAYER
facts.text: Resetting before the map-transition auto-save returns you slightly earlier, and START OF LAYER on the title screen is another way to resume.

evidence.quote: マップ切り替え時のオートセーブが入る前にリセットすることで少し前に戻れる。
evidence.translation: Resetting before the auto-save on map transition returns you a little earlier.

evidence.quote: タイトル画面の「START OF LAYER」で再開する、という手もある。
evidence.translation: There is also the option of resuming with 'START OF LAYER' on the title screen.

facts.subject: Shine Circular
facts.text: The SP consumption of Shine Circular is increased to 150.

evidence.quote: シャインサーキュラーの消費SPが150に上昇

facts.subject: Hard Mode
facts.text: Hard mode is added and selectable when starting a new game from the 2nd playthrough onward, with increased enemy levels.

evidence.quote: ハードモード追加。2周目以降ニューゲーム開始時に選択可。敵のレベルが上昇している。
evidence.translation: Hard mode added. Selectable when starting a new game from the 2nd playthrough onward. Enemy levels are increased.

facts.subject: Non-heroine PC characters
facts.text: Non-heroine PC characters have decreased SP consumption and increased sword skill usage rate.

evidence.quote: ヒロイン以外のPCキャラの消費SP減少、ソードスキル使用率向上
evidence.translation: Non-heroine PC characters SP consumption decreased, sword skill usage rate increased.

facts.subject: Ultimate Ruler
facts.text: Selecting Forgotten Guardian at the 76th floor teleport gate screen initiates a battle with Ultimate Ruler, whose boss level is 150 on Normal Mode.

evidence.quote: 76層の転移門画面にて忘却の番人を選択するとアルティメットルーラーとのバトルになる。...ボスのレベルはノーマルモードで150（本編ボスのヒースクリフが140）。
evidence.translation: Selecting Forgotten Guardian at the 76th floor teleport gate screen initiates a battle with Ultimate Ruler. Boss level is 150 on Normal Mode (main story boss Heathcliff is 140).

facts.subject: Labyrinth of Condemnation
facts.text: Players enter from the 76th floor teleport gate screen and cannot escape until defeating Fatal Reaper at the deepest part.

evidence.quote: 76層の転移門画面より突入する。...最深部でフェイタルリーパーを撃破するまで脱出不可。
evidence.translation: Enter from the 76th floor teleport gate screen... Cannot escape until defeating Fatal Reaper at the deepest part.

facts.subject: Fatal Reaper
facts.text: Fatal Reaper is at the deepest part and cannot escape until defeating it, with its level being the same as Ultimate Ruler.

evidence.quote: 最深部でフェイタルリーパーを撃破するまで脱出不可。レベルはアルティメットルーラーと同じ。
evidence.translation: Cannot escape until defeating Fatal Reaper at the deepest part. Level is the same as Ultimate Ruler.

facts.subject: Labyrinth of Condemnation
facts.text: Treasure chests respawn infinitely every time you enter, but there are one-way branching paths and you cannot obtain all treasure chests at once.

evidence.quote: 宝箱は入る度に無限に復活するが、一方通行の分かれ道があり一度に宝箱を全て取得することは出来ない。
evidence.translation: Treasure chests respawn infinitely every time you enter, but there are one-way branching paths and you cannot obtain all treasure chests at once.

facts.subject: School Swimsuit
facts.text: Entering the code allows you to buy as many school swimsuits as you like at the 76th floor armor shop for 5万 col.

evidence.quote: 初回生産分の購入特典。コードを入れると76層の防具屋にて5万colで好きなだけ買えるスクール水着。
evidence.translation: First production bonus. Entering the code allows you to buy as many school swimsuits as you like at the 76th floor armor shop for 5万 col.

facts.subject: School Swimsuit
facts.text: Other body armor is guaranteed 30 defense, but this has only 15 defense, while providing bonuses of 10 to attack power, 50 to AGL, and 8% to evasion rate.

evidence.quote: 他の体防具は防御力30は保証されているがこちらは防御力は15しかなく、これは軽装タイプの腕防具と同等。...一応攻撃力に10、AGLに50、回避率に8%の補正はつく。
evidence.translation: Other body armor is guaranteed 30 defense, but this has only 15 defense, equivalent to light arm armor... It provides bonuses of 10 to attack power, 50 to AGL, and 8% to evasion rate.

facts.subject: 貪欲なる抗窟1
facts.text: Upon entering Greed Hole 1, ignore the magic circle on the right for now and go straight to Greed Hole 2, then return to the previous area and examine the device next to the magic circle to proceed forward.

evidence.quote: ◎**「貪欲なる抗窟1」** へ入ったら、右手の魔方陣はひとまずスルーし**「貪欲なる抗窟2」** へ直進...◎手間のエリアに戻って魔法陣横の装置を調べると先へ進めるようになる
evidence.translation: Upon entering Greed Hole 1, ignore the magic circle on the right for now and go straight to Greed Hole 2, then return to the previous area and examine the device next to the magic circle to proceed forward.

facts.subject: 敗者達の峡谷
facts.text: Valley Blooming Herbs can be gathered from 3 locations in Ravine of the Defeated: near where Giant Spider was, near the second turning point of cliff climbing, and near the rock on the left slightly before the exit.

evidence.quote: ◎**「谷間に咲く薬草」** は**「敗者達の峡谷」** で3ヶ所より採取可能...ジャイアントスパイダーが居た付近・崖登りの2回目の折り返し地点付近・出口少し手前の左側の岩付近
evidence.translation: Valley Blooming Herbs can be gathered from 3 locations in Ravine of the Defeated: near where Giant Spider was, near the second turning point of cliff climbing, and near the rock on the left slightly before the exit.

facts.subject: クリムゾンスピナー
facts.text: Crimson Spinner is in Pilgrim Road of Predators.

evidence.quote: ◎**「クリムゾンスピナー」** は**「捕食者の巡礼路」** にいる
evidence.translation: Crimson Spinner is in Pilgrim Road of Predators.

facts.subject: オーバーレイスライム
facts.text: Proceed along the path and defeat NM Overlay Slime in a sub-event at Serpent Tail Facing the Sky.

evidence.quote: ◎道なりに進み**「空臨む蛇の尻尾」** でサブイベント、NM**「オーバーレイスライム」** を倒す
evidence.translation: Proceed along the path and defeat NM Overlay Slime in a sub-event at Serpent Tail Facing the Sky.

facts.subject: ファットスライム
facts.text: Teleport to Corridor of the Crawling Fool, advance inside to defeat NM Fat Slime and activate switches, and defeating all 3 will activate the central teleporter to Silence Verdant Woodland.

evidence.quote: ◎転移して**「地這う愚者の回廊」** へ、目の前にある転移装置はまだ起動しない為、奥に進みNM**「ファットスライム」** を倒しスイッチを起動させていく...◎3体全て倒せば中央にあった転移装置が動くようになるので**「静寂なる新緑の林道」** へ転移
evidence.translation: Teleport to Corridor of the Crawling Fool, advance inside to defeat NM Fat Slime and activate switches, and defeating all 3 will activate the central teleporter to Silence Verdant Woodland.

facts.subject: ゴブリンリーダー
facts.text: NM Goblin Leader is located in the deepest part of Cave of Laughing Demons immediately down-left from Pioneer Ground of Rampaging War Demons.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ゴブリンリーダー」** は**「荒ぶる戦鬼達の開拓地」** からすぐ左下に下りた**「嘲笑いし鬼達の洞穴」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Goblin Leader is located in the deepest part of Cave of Laughing Demons immediately down-left from Pioneer Ground of Rampaging War Demons.

facts.subject: フレアドラゴン
facts.text: To head to the labyrinth, first proceed through the right forest Fragrant Leaves Maze, and after exiting the forest go right to face NM Flare Dragon, triggering a sub-event to search for a weapon to defeat the dragon.

evidence.quote: ◎迷宮区へ向かうには、まず右の森**「芳葉たる迷道」** を進む...◎森を抜けた先で右へ進みNM**「フレアドラゴン」** と対面。ドラゴンを倒すための武器を探すサブイベントを起こす
evidence.translation: To head to the labyrinth, first proceed through the right forest Fragrant Leaves Maze, and after exiting the forest go right to face NM Flare Dragon, triggering a sub-event to search for a weapon to defeat the dragon.

facts.subject: 竜破石
facts.text: Defeat Iron Golem in the northwest to obtain key item Dragon Buster Stone, return and give it to NPC Elliot to obtain Dragon Buster Sword, and defeating NM Flare Dragon allows progress forward.

evidence.quote: ◎北西にいる**「アイアンゴーレム」** を倒し貴重品**「竜破石」** を入手...◎戻ってNPCエリオットに渡すと _『竜破剣』_ を入手、それからNM**「フレアドラゴン」** を倒すと先へ進めるようになる
evidence.translation: Defeat Iron Golem in the northwest to obtain key item Dragon Buster Stone, return and give it to NPC Elliot to obtain Dragon Buster Sword, and defeating NM Flare Dragon allows progress forward.

facts.subject: 許されざる歌声
facts.text: For the quest Unforgivable Song, only Sirens from Slope of the Kneeling Sunset right outside Floor 79 count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『許されざる歌声』_ の**「セイレーン」** は、79層出てすぐの**「平伏せし落陽の勾配」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest Unforgivable Song, only Sirens from Slope of the Kneeling Sunset right outside Floor 79 count as targets.

evidence.quote: 11| 許されざる歌声| 79層平伏せし落陽の勾配にいるセイレーンを7体倒す

facts.subject: ザインリザードマン
facts.text: NM Zain Lizardman is in the immediate vicinity of Lake Path of Bundled Cascades.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ザインリザードマン」** は**「束ねし瀑布の湖道」** のすぐ近くにいる
evidence.translation: NM Zain Lizardman is in the immediate vicinity of Lake Path of Bundled Cascades.

facts.subject: 嘆く犠牲の留置所
facts.text: Because keys in Detention of Lamenting Victims are placed randomly on each floor, you must search all treasure chests.

evidence.quote: ◎**「嘆く犠牲の留置所」** の鍵は各フロアでランダムに配置されている為、宝箱を調べ尽くすしかない
evidence.translation: Because keys in Detention of Lamenting Victims are placed randomly on each floor, you must search all treasure chests.

facts.subject: ダークネス
facts.text: NM Darkness is in Road of Fleeing Dead Spirits before the labyrinth.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ダークネス」** は迷宮区前の**「亡者が逃げ惑いし道」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Darkness is in Road of Fleeing Dead Spirits before the labyrinth.

facts.subject: 砂漠に散った無数の命
facts.text: For the quest Deadly Desert, only Scorpions from Desert of Sun-Drenched Heat Waves right outside Floor 81 count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『砂漠に散った無数の命』_ の**「スコーピオン」** は、81層出てすぐの**「陽光注ぐ熱波の砂漠」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest Deadly Desert, only Scorpions from Desert of Sun-Drenched Heat Waves right outside Floor 81 count as targets.

evidence.quote: 17| 砂漠に散った無数の命| 81層陽光注ぐ熱波の砂漠にいるスコーピオンを10匹倒す

facts.subject: 封印されし蜃気楼の砂地
facts.text: Clear the four ruins visible from Sealed Mirage Sands by defeating Shadow Demon in the deepest part of each ruin, and defeating all 4 Shadow Demons removes the roadblock obstacle, allowing progress to the labyrinth.

evidence.quote: ◎**「封印されし蜃気楼の砂地」** から見える４つの遺跡を攻略していく。各遺跡の最奥部にいる**「シャドウデーモン」** を倒せば良い...◎**「シャドウデーモン」** 4体を倒すと通行止めオブジェクトが消え、迷宮区攻略へ
evidence.translation: Clear the four ruins visible from Sealed Mirage Sands by defeating Shadow Demon in the deepest part of each ruin, and defeating all 4 Shadow Demons removes the roadblock obstacle, allowing progress to the labyrinth.

facts.subject: ブレイザーデーモン
facts.text: NM Blazer Demon is in Trial of Malice-Drifting Annihilation on the west front, and the key for Trial of Mocking Mimicry is in the middle chest of the upper-right small room.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ブレイザーデーモン」** は西側手前の**「邪気漂う殲滅の試練」** にいる...◎**「嘲笑せし擬態の試練」** の鍵は右上の小部屋・真ん中の宝箱。他はミミックと武器宝箱
evidence.translation: NM Blazer Demon is in Trial of Malice-Drifting Annihilation on the west front, and the key for Trial of Mocking Mimicry is in the middle chest of the upper-right small room.

facts.subject: グレーターバンディット
facts.text: Seven Light Polar Stones can be gathered at 3 spots in Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls, and NM Greater Bandit is below the cliff of Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls.

evidence.quote: ◎**「七光極石」** は**「双壁の交叉する晶座」** で3ヶ所より採取可能...◎NM**「グレーターバンディット」** は**「双壁の交叉する晶座」** の崖下にいる
evidence.translation: Seven Light Polar Stones can be gathered at 3 spots in Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls, and NM Greater Bandit is below the cliff of Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls.

facts.subject: 渦巻く旋流の積層
facts.text: Press the respective switches in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 2 from above the cliff, and in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 4 from below the cliff.

evidence.quote: ◎崖上から**「深き地へ至る崖廊2」** の奥、崖下から**「深き地へ至る崖廊4」** の奥それぞれのスイッチを押せば良い
evidence.translation: Press the respective switches in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 2 from above the cliff, and in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 4 from below the cliff.

facts.subject: フィアーツリー
facts.text: NM Fear Tree is in Woodland Path of Protecting Trees heading west from Crossroads of Fierce Travelers on Floor 83.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「フィアーツリー」** は83層の**「猛き旅人の分かれ道」** から西へ進んだ**「護りし樹木達の林道」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Fear Tree is in Woodland Path of Protecting Trees heading west from Crossroads of Fierce Travelers on Floor 83.

facts.subject: 賢しき鬼達の集落
facts.text: The key to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 1 is the Commercial District Key at the far upper-right, and keys to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 2 are the Hall Key at the far left and King's Key at the far upper-right.

evidence.quote: ◎**「賢しき鬼達の集落1」** から先に進む鍵は一番右上の**「商業区の鍵」**...◎**「賢しき鬼達の集落2」** から先に進む鍵は左端の**「広間の鍵」** と、一番右上の**「王の鍵」**
evidence.translation: The key to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 1 is the Commercial District Key at the far upper-right, and keys to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 2 are the Hall Key at the far left and King's Key at the far upper-right.

facts.subject: アントプリンセス
facts.text: NM Ant Princess is in the deepest part of Road Connecting to the Ruler reached by going lower-right from entrance to Gouged Cavern 2 and heading straight, and on labyrinth 2F and 3F you form a party with Strea, with no treasure chests on 2F.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「アントプリンセス」** は、入り口から右下⇒**「抉られた岩洞2」** と進み、直進していった先の**「統べし者へ連なる道」** の最奥部にいる...◎迷宮区2階・3階はストレアとパーティーを組むことになる。2階は宝箱なし
evidence.translation: NM Ant Princess is in the deepest part of Road Connecting to the Ruler reached by going lower-right from entrance to Gouged Cavern 2 and heading straight, and on labyrinth 2F and 3F you form a party with Strea, with no treasure chests on 2F.

facts.subject: オークジェネラル
facts.text: To proceed through the west forest Bewildering Tree of Wandering right outside Floor 85, you must first defeat Orc General on the east side of east forest Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility.

evidence.quote: ◎85層出てすぐからの西の森**「惑わせし彷徨の迷樹」** を進むには、先に東の森**「さざめく豊穣の林道」** 東側にいる**「オークジェネラル」** を倒す必要がある
evidence.translation: To proceed through the west forest Bewildering Tree of Wandering right outside Floor 85, you must first defeat Orc General on the east side of east forest Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility.

facts.subject: 迷いの森から来た男
facts.text: For the quest Bewildering Forest, only Orc Warriors in Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『迷いの森から来た男』_ の**「オークウォーリア」** は**「さざめく豊穣の林道」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest Bewildering Forest, only Orc Warriors in Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility count as targets.

evidence.quote: 29| 迷いの森から来た男| 85層さざめく豊穣の林道にいるオークウォーリアを9匹倒す

facts.subject: エメラルドドラゴン
facts.text: NM Emerald Dragon is in the deepest part of cave Dwelling of the Hunted Hermit to the west of Lakeside of Wavering Illusions.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「エメラルドドラゴン」** は**「幻燈のたゆたう湖畔」** の西にある洞窟**「追われし隠者の棲家」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Emerald Dragon is in the deepest part of cave Dwelling of the Hunted Hermit to the west of Lakeside of Wavering Illusions.

facts.subject: アンデッドはふたたび
facts.text: For the quest The Undead Return, only Lost Soldiers in Valley Where Soldiers Walked right outside Floor 86 count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『アンデッドはふたたび』_ の**「ロストソルジャー」** は86層出てすぐの**「兵士達が歩みし谷」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest The Undead Return, only Lost Soldiers in Valley Where Soldiers Walked right outside Floor 86 count as targets.

evidence.quote: 32| アンデッドはふたたび| 86層兵士達が歩みし谷にいるロストソルジャーを13匹倒す

facts.subject: ネクロマンサー
facts.text: NM Necromancer is in the deepest part of Fortress of Living Corpses beyond Ancient Battlefield of Bleeding Fierce Combat.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ネクロマンサー」** は**「血を流す激戦の古戦場」** の先にある**「生ける屍達の砦」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Necromancer is in the deepest part of Fortress of Living Corpses beyond Ancient Battlefield of Bleeding Fierce Combat.

facts.subject: ナイトストーカー
facts.text: NM Nightstalker is in the upper-left of Ancient Underground Fortress after exiting Chained Stratified Cavern Lower Layer.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ナイトストーカー」** は**「連鎖する積層の岩窟 下層」** を出た先にある**「地底に眠る古の城塞」** 左上にいる
evidence.translation: NM Nightstalker is in the upper-left of Ancient Underground Fortress after exiting Chained Stratified Cavern Lower Layer.

facts.subject: インビジブル
facts.text: For labyrinth missions, crossing in front of target monsters on floors other than 1F results in failure, so using battle skill Invisible makes clearing easier.

evidence.quote: ◎迷宮区ミッションは、1階以外だと対象モンスターの前を横切るとアウトなのでバトルスキル**「インビジブル」** を使用するとクリアしやすいだろう
evidence.translation: For labyrinth missions, crossing in front of target monsters on floors other than 1F results in failure, so using battle skill Invisible makes clearing easier.

facts.subject: ネクロドラゴン
facts.text: In Dragon Seal Ruins, both ends follow the flow of pressing switch -> defeating inner NM -> opening door and destroying crystal, after which defeat NM Necro Dragon in the central chamber.

evidence.quote: ◎封竜遺跡は、両端とも スイッチを押す⇒奥のNMを倒す⇒扉を開けクリスタルを壊す の流れ。その後、中央の間のNM**「ネクロドラゴン」** を倒す
evidence.translation: In Dragon Seal Ruins, both ends follow the flow of pressing switch -> defeating inner NM -> opening door and destroying crystal, after which defeat NM Necro Dragon in the central chamber.

facts.subject: グラトニーラフレシア
facts.text: NM Gluttony Rafflesia is in Cool Shaded Rain Rifts ahead.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「グラトニーラフレシア」** はその先の**「冷涼なる日陰の雨裂」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Gluttony Rafflesia is in Cool Shaded Rain Rifts ahead.

facts.subject: 塔を守るトカゲ
facts.object: エルダーリザードマン
facts.text: For quest Tower of Lizards, only Elder Lizardmen in Single Tower Controlling Torrents count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト**「塔を守るトカゲ」** のエルダーリザードマンは、**「奔流を御す片塔」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For quest Tower of Lizards, only Elder Lizardmen in Single Tower Controlling Torrents count as targets.

evidence.quote: 40 | 塔を守るトカゲ| 89層奔流を御す片塔にいるエルダーリザードマンを10匹倒す

facts.subject: ブレイズアーマー
facts.object: 天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊
facts.text: NM Blaze Armor is in the deepest part of Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky reached after clearing the twin towers.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ブレイズアーマー」** は双塔クリア後に飛ぶ**「天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Blaze Armor is in the deepest part of Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky reached after clearing the twin towers.

facts.subject: インプレグナブル
facts.object: 空仰ぐ草木の浮遊大陸3
facts.text: NM Impregnable is in Floating Continent of Sky-Facing Vegetation 3.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「インプレグナブル」** は**「空仰ぐ草木の浮遊大陸3」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Impregnable is in Floating Continent of Sky-Facing Vegetation 3.

facts.subject: ハチミツ
facts.text: For Honey on the hill right outside Floor 90, if 5 cannot be gathered in one day, return and rest at the inn to advance the day before gathering again.

evidence.quote: ◎（90層出てすぐの丘にある**「ハチミツ」** は、一日で5個集まらなければ一旦戻り、宿屋で日をまたいでから再採取しよう）
evidence.translation: For Honey on the hill right outside Floor 90, if 5 cannot be gathered in one day, return and rest at the inn to advance the day before gathering again.

facts.subject: 泡沫たる空虚の迷道
facts.text: Warp route Left->Left yields Gray-White Ore x10, Left->Right->Left->Right yields mob weapon x1 and mimic, and Left->Right->Left->Left->Right meets the woman to receive the stone to insert into Wind Corridor of Gathering Magic Seals.

evidence.quote: ◎ワープ経路は _『左⇒左』_ で灰白鉱x10、 _『左⇒右⇒左⇒右』_ で使用中の種類のモブ武器x1・ミミック...◎道なりに次の**「魔印の集積する風廊」** まで進み石をハメ込んでいく
evidence.translation: Warp route Left->Left yields Gray-White Ore x10, Left->Right->Left->Right yields mob weapon x1 and mimic, and Left->Right->Left->Left->Right meets the woman to receive the stone to insert into Wind Corridor of Gathering Magic Seals.

facts.subject: ロードオブウィンド
facts.object: 俊敏なる飛竜の巣 上層
facts.text: NM Lord of Wind is in Agile Wyvern Nest Upper Layer down-left from Middle Layer; defeat nearby Red Blast, then return to Spiral Path to Abyss Green and go to Windless Abyss Green to defeat Red Blast again to reach the labyrinth.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ロードオブウィンド」** は中層から左下へ進んだ**「俊敏なる飛竜の巣 上層」** にいる...◎最初の**「深淵の緑地への螺旋道」** へ戻り、右側のエリア**「風なき深淵の緑地」** へ進むと**「レッドブラスト」** と再戦。倒して迷宮区へ
evidence.translation: NM Lord of Wind is in Agile Wyvern Nest Upper Layer down-left from Middle Layer; defeat nearby Red Blast, then return to Spiral Path to Abyss Green and go to Windless Abyss Green to defeat Red Blast again to reach the labyrinth.

facts.subject: 迷宮区1階
facts.text: In labyrinth 1F, bring the normal teleport stone from the right end to the broken teleport stone on the left end, and exchange it to teleport to 2F.

evidence.quote: ◎迷宮区1階の右端に＜正常な転移石＞があるので、左端の壊れた転移石の所まで持って行き、交換して2階へ転移
evidence.translation: In labyrinth 1F, bring the normal teleport stone from the right end to the broken teleport stone on the left end, and exchange it to teleport to 2F.

facts.subject: ヘブンリィソード
facts.object: 94層・隠された古代の宝物庫 東
facts.text: NM Heavenly Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault East and NM Inferno Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault West, where teleport crystals cannot be used.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ヘブンリィソード」** は**「94層・隠された古代の宝物庫 東」** 、NMインフェルノソード」は**「94層・隠された古代の宝物庫 西」** にいる...◎注：宝物庫のみ転移結晶の使用不可
evidence.translation: NM Heavenly Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault East and NM Inferno Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault West, where teleport crystals cannot be used.

facts.subject: 双璧の交わる戦場
facts.text: NM Gaia Breaker is in Forest Filled with Deep Sleep; after defeating it, return to the cave and go upper-right to gather Flower of Life in Battlefield of Intersecting Twin Walls.

evidence.quote: ◎**「深き眠りに満ちた森林」** にNM**「ガイアブレイカー」** がいる...**「双璧の交わる戦場」** で**「命の花」** が採取可能
evidence.translation: NM Gaia Breaker is in Forest Filled with Deep Sleep; after defeating it, return to the cave and go upper-right to gather Flower of Life in Battlefield of Intersecting Twin Walls.

facts.subject: 策謀なる転の回廊
facts.text: Corridor of Scheming Turn is a puzzle: answer from the start is left 1, 3, right 4, 4 in order, leading to labyrinth exploration.

evidence.quote: ◎**「策謀なる転の回廊」** は謎解き。（答え：最初から順に左から1、3、右から4、4）⇒迷宮区攻略
evidence.translation: Corridor of Scheming Turn is a puzzle: answer from the start is left 1, 3, right 4, 4 in order, leading to labyrinth exploration.

facts.subject: アルベリヒ
facts.text: Entering the map triggers a sub-event battle with Lv200 Alberich; for quest Defeat That Knight!, Rune Knights spawn only one at a time on Path of Labyrinth Eaters right outside Floor 97, so wait for respawns after defeating them.

evidence.quote: ◎マップ入ってすぐサブイベント、Lv200**「アルベリヒ」** と戦闘...◎クエスト _『あの騎士を討て!』_ の**「ルーンナイト」** は97層出てすぐの**「迷宮を食らう者達の道」** に1体ずつしか沸かないので、倒したら沸き待ち
evidence.translation: Entering the map triggers a sub-event battle with Lv200 Alberich; for quest Defeat That Knight!, Rune Knights spawn only one at a time on Path of Labyrinth Eaters right outside Floor 97, so wait for respawns after defeating them.

facts.subject: 紅玉彩る剣の塔2階
facts.text: In Ruby Adorned Sword Tower 2F, pressing switches in order of right-middle -> upper-right -> left-middle opens the door to advance forward.

evidence.quote: ◎**「紅玉彩る剣の塔2階」** は右真ん中⇒右上⇒左真ん中の順にスイッチを押せば先へ進む扉が開く
evidence.translation: In Ruby Adorned Sword Tower 2F, pressing switches in order of right-middle -> upper-right -> left-middle opens the door to advance forward.

facts.subject: 100層紅玉宮
facts.text: Floor 100 Ruby Palace: No field, 4 consecutive battles, and after 4 consecutive battles you receive an individual ending with the girl chosen as your partner.

evidence.quote: **【100層紅玉宮】**...4連戦。...4連戦後にパートナーとして選んだ子と個別エンディング。
evidence.translation: Floor 100 Ruby Palace: No field, 4 consecutive battles, and after 4 consecutive battles you receive an individual ending with the girl chosen as your partner.

facts.subject: ピナ
facts.text: Free -> hit rate up, HP recovery; Preserve Life -> defense up, status abnormality recovery; Reliable -> attack up, defense up; Versatile -> attack up, speed up; Helpful -> SP recovery, status abnormality recovery; Support -> speed up, SP recovery.

evidence.quote: 【自由】→命中率アップ、HP回復...【サポート】→速度アップ、SP回復
evidence.translation: Free -> hit rate up, HP recovery; Preserve Life -> defense up, status abnormality recovery; Reliable -> attack up, defense up; Versatile -> attack up, speed up; Helpful -> SP recovery, status abnormality recovery; Support -> speed up, SP recovery.

facts.subject: ピナ
facts.text: Gray-White Crystal -> hit rate up... Diamond Crystal -> defense up; Keen Blade Crystal -> status abnormality recovery; level up with 100 stones or 20 minerals or 10 crystals.

evidence.quote: 【灰白晶】→命中率アップ...【金剛晶】→防御力アップ...石100個 or 鉱20個 or 晶10個 でレベルアップ。
evidence.translation: Gray-White Crystal -> hit rate up... Diamond Crystal -> defense up; Keen Blade Crystal -> status abnormality recovery; level up with 100 stones or 20 minerals or 10 crystals.

facts.subject: 友好度
facts.text: RANK5 0~14 [-], RANK4 15~99 [Acquaintance], RANK3 100~299 [Good Friends], RANK2 300~499 [Intimate], RANK1 500 [Peerless].

evidence.quote: RANK5 0~14 「—」...RANK1 500 「双壁を成す者」
evidence.translation: RANK5 0~14 [-], RANK4 15~99 [Acquaintance], RANK3 100~299 [Good Friends], RANK2 300~499 [Intimate], RANK1 500 [Peerless].

facts.subject: 友好度
facts.text: When RANK reaches 3, "Talk" and "Walk the city together" options are added; when RANK reaches 2, "Form party" and "Gift weapon" options are added; when Friendship reaches 400 or more, "Gift armor" option is added.

evidence.quote: RANKが3になると、「会話する」、「一緒に街を歩こう」の項目が追加される...友好度が400以上になると、「防具をプレゼント」の項目が追加される
evidence.translation: When RANK reaches 3, "Talk" and "Walk the city together" options are added; when RANK reaches 2, "Form party" and "Gift weapon" options are added; when Friendship reaches 400 or more, "Gift armor" option is added.

facts.subject: ヒュージポイズンクラブ
facts.text: In the Flowing Water Corridor, activating the device at the far end opens the door beside the entrance and the Huge Poison Crab appears; defeating it lets you go to the 79th floor labyrinth Dragon Palace of Rushing Waves.

evidence.quote: 一番奥の装置を起動すると入口横の扉が開いてヒュージポイズンクラブが出現
evidence.translation: When you activate the device at the far end, the door beside the entrance opens and the Huge Poison Crab appears

evidence.quote: 倒すと79層迷宮区「奔波の竜宮」に行ける
evidence.translation: Defeating it lets you go to the 79th floor labyrinth Dragon Palace of Rushing Waves

facts.subject: 天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊
facts.text: The route runs from the Spring of Twin Streams to the Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky, and from the Floating Cloud Corridor to the 89th floor labyrinth Mausoleum of Muddy Torrents.

evidence.quote: 「双流統べし湧水場」→「天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊」
evidence.translation: Spring of Twin Streams → Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky

evidence.quote: 「天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊」→89層迷宮区「濁流たる霊廟」
evidence.translation: Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky → 89th floor labyrinth Mausoleum of Muddy Torrents

facts.subject: 妖精イベント
facts.text: After the 76th floor boss, an event at the teleport gate has Klein mention a rumor of a fairy event in the east forest.

evidence.quote: 転移門前でイベント、クラインから東の森の妖精イベントの噂を聞く
evidence.translation: Event in front of the teleport gate; hear from Klein the rumor of a fairy event in the east forest

facts.subject: シノン
facts.object: NMスカーレットディザスター
facts.text: After clearing floor 86, take Sinon to the 86th floor Forward Base of the Living Dead 3F and fight NM Scarlet Disaster; afterwards Sinon learns a new sword skill.

evidence.quote: シノンを連れて86層「生ける屍達の前線基地3階」へ行き
evidence.translation: Take Sinon and go to the 86th floor Forward Base of the Living Dead 3F

evidence.quote: NMスカーレットディザスターと戦闘後シノンが新たなソードスキルを覚える
evidence.translation: After fighting NM Scarlet Disaster, Sinon learns a new sword skill

facts.subject: 新婚旅行イベント
facts.text: After clearing floor 87, talk to the depressed Asuna in Arc Sophia, then in daytime take Asuna to the 83rd floor town and choose the scenic spot to trigger the honeymoon event.

evidence.quote: 【87層まで攻略】...アークソフィアで落ち込んでいるアスナに話しかける
evidence.translation: Floors cleared through 87 ... Talk to the depressed Asuna in Arc Sophia

evidence.quote: 昼にアスナを連れて83層街で「景色のいい場所」を選択すると
evidence.translation: In daytime, take Asuna along and choose the scenic spot in the 83rd floor town

facts.subject: 祝福の儀式
facts.text: After clearing floor 86, talking to Asuna in Arc Sophia advances the quest Ritual of Blessing.

evidence.quote: 【86層まで攻略】...アークソフィアでアスナに話しかけるとクエスト「祝福の儀式」が進展
evidence.translation: Floors cleared through 86 ... Talking to Asuna in Arc Sophia advances the quest Ritual of Blessing

facts.subject: 進化の鉱石
facts.text: After clearing floor 81, talking to Silica in Arc Sophia gives information about the Evolution Ore.

evidence.quote: 【81層まで攻略】...アークソフィアでシリカに話しかけると「進化の鉱石」の情報を得る
evidence.translation: Floors cleared through 81 ... Talking to Silica in Arc Sophia gives information about the Evolution Ore

facts.subject: 暴食の寝座
facts.text: Going to the 84th floor labyrinth 2F forces a party with Strea up to the boss room, and you cannot go back.

evidence.quote: 84層迷宮区２階に行くとボス部屋まで強制でストレアとPT、後ろには戻れません
evidence.translation: When you go to the 84th floor labyrinth 2F you are forced into a party with Strea up to the boss room, and you cannot go back
